facts.business: Dhruv Consultancy Services Limited provides engineering consultancy services for infrastructure projects including highways, multimodal logistics, airports, metro systems, railways, ports and public infrastructure.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Material reversal of unbilled revenue of Rs 37.73 Crores due to revisions in management estimates relating to expected project costs, stage of completion, contractual recoverability and/or customer acceptance criteria for certain contracts.

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgment and estimation including assessment of total estimated costs to complete and evaluation of variable consideration
Contracted services not delivered may invoke penal clauses by customers impacting revenue accuracy
High degree of estimation uncertainty in evaluating assumptions and judgments applied by management for revenue recognition
